header.author: Pyramid Texts
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:egy:pyramid-texts:neith:translit, from the UD Egyptian-PC treebank of the Pyramid Texts (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. notes.58.41a: An offering formula from the Pyramid Texts. jbꜣ is obscure (perhaps a word-play on the offering's name); ḏbꜣ is the offering item named in the rubric, of uncertain kind. The deleted words {ꞽm ⸗tn} are not translated.

nodes.text: Recitation: Osiris Neith, take for yourself the Eye of Horus, with which he has *jbꜣ*-ed. *Ḏbꜣ*: 1.
